snippet.title: Pandora's Toybox 丨 Launch Trailer
snippet.description: Pandora's Toybox is a fast-paced Roguelite God Simulator. Play as Epimetheus to guide human civilization on a randomly generated pixel world. Watch settlements grow into city-states, defend against heretics, and spread your faith to build a divine legacy.
